name: Esoteric Love
source:
Have you ever wondered what it would be like to date the Bigfoot? What about the Loch Ness Monster? Welcome to Esoteric Love! A Dating Simulator Game where you will meet four lovely cryptids. Will you be able to impress them?

[From [url=https://pedroaulicino.itch.io/esoteric-love]Itch.io[/url]]
translation: 你有沒有想過和大腳怪約會會是什麼感覺？那尼斯湖水怪呢？歡迎來到《Esoteric Love》！這是一款戀愛模擬遊戲，你將結識4位可愛的神秘生物。你能贏得他們的好感嗎？[引自[url=https://pedroaulicino.itch.io/esoteric-love]Itch.io[/url]]
